title: README examples don't match the code
issue:
README examples don't match what slugify returns

I copied the second example from the README:

```ts
slugify("Crème Brûlée Recipe", { sep: "_" });
// => "creme_brulee_recipe"
```

but I get `"creme-brulee-recipe"`: the underscore is ignored. The `maxLength` example doesn't match either (I get `"a-very-long-blog"`, not `"a-very-long-blog-pos"`).

So is the README wrong or is the code wrong? Please fix whichever one it is.
